counting_rule.independent_unit: One upstream repository/project and one underlying issue/defect, not each test selector.

related_issue_family.title: Sampling ~10× slower when using same MCMC object after warmup() vs creating new MCMC with num_warmup=0
related_issue_family.relationship: Adjacent warmup/resume lifecycle symptom, primarily a NUTS performance slowdown under a different environment; no same AIES/ESS batched-key ValueError mechanism established.

related_issue_family.title: HMC with vectorized chains crashes when re-ran with changed parameters
related_issue_family.relationship: Adjacent repeated-run/vectorized-chain defect in HMC; reported vmap rank error and mutation of HMC._sample_fn, not ensemble PRNG-key replacement.

related_issue_family.title: jit_model_args=True causes BarkerMH and ensemble kernels to ignore model arguments in subsequent runs
related_issue_family.relationship: Closest adjacent ensemble-kernel issue family member; changed model arguments are ignored under jit_model_args, a different cache/model-argument mechanism from the #1916 PRNG-key shape failure.

related_issue_family.title: SA with vectorized chains crashes when re-ran with changed parameters (similar to #2338)
related_issue_family.relationship: Related to #2338's repeated-run/vmap rank failure for SA; different kernel and error path from #1916.

issue_family_disposition.broader_family: Repeated MCMC execution / warmup-resume lifecycle and vectorized chain state handling.
issue_family_disposition.disposition: Retain NumPyro #1916 as one provisional distinct defect case. Do not count any other NumPyro issue as another independent project/case. Preserve the related-issue cluster as context; Panel A must confirm whether any later issue reveals a competing or broader mechanism.
